## 2026-10-11

- Worked on plotting sin(x).

```{python}
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200)
plt.plot(x, np.sin(x))
plt.title("sin(x)")
plt.xlabel("x")
plt.ylabel("sin(x)")
plt.show()
```

## 2026-10-12

- Worked on plotting cos(x).
- Derivatives:
  $$\frac{d}{dx}\sin(x) = \cos(x)$$
  $$\frac{d}{dx}\cos(x) = -\sin(x)$$

```{python}
x = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200)
plt.plot(x, np.cos(x))
plt.title("cos(x)")
plt.xlabel("x")
plt.ylabel("cos(x)")
plt.show()
```
